selection: First row of each AND-size bin in the already frozen panel's original metadata order; no candidate counts, failures, timing or runtime used.
no_score_scope: Retain real Student/19D preparation cost and structural delta features, mask only normalized predicted-local-delay delta from the proxy/feedback feature tensor.
no_pairs_scope: Keep explicit interaction weights zero throughout calibration and disable adjacent-pair feedback descriptors. Nonlinear DAG propagation still couples outputs.
no_repair_scope: Retain every failed request; do not queue its feasibility repair. The next budget request may explore elsewhere; no free relabeling or extra mapping.
scope: Supplementary controlled contribution study selected during the still-running formal panel, before any supplementary outcome. It does not retune or replace the frozen sixteen-design comparison. Four designs and three repeated seeds do not prove generalization. No universal superiority threshold is introduced.
